`interface ITextRenderer`<br/>
**Known subtypes:** [`GlyphTextRenderer`](/reference/text/glyphtextrenderer/)<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.font` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [ITextRenderer.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/font/ITextRenderer.java)

Measures and draws the strings of one kind of font.

## Description

[`DrawText`](/reference/text/drawtext/) and [`TextInfo`](/reference/text/textinfo/) reach it through [`IFont.getTextRenderer`](/reference/text/ifont/#IFont-method-getTextRenderer).
Implement it for a font that is not made of glyphs; for a font of glyphs, extend [`GlyphTextRenderer`](/reference/text/glyphtextrenderer/), which lays out, kerns and styles the text for you.
Positions and sizes are in design pixels.

## Method details

<a id="ITextRenderer-method-drawText"></a>

### drawText

`FontBounds drawText(double x, double y, String text, TextInfo info)` <span class="joid-qualifier">abstract</span>

Draws `text` on one line with its top-left corner at `x`, `y`, and returns its bounds.
JOID calls it on the render thread, during a frame.

`FontBounds drawText(double x, double y, String text, TextInfo info, double runX, double runY, double runWidth, double runHeight)` <span class="joid-qualifier">default</span>

Draws `text` as a part of a longer run whose box is `runX`, `runY`, `runWidth`, `runHeight`, so that a gradient spreads over the whole run.
By default it ignores the run and calls `drawText(x, y, text, info)`.

<a id="ITextRenderer-method-getLineHeight"></a>

### getLineHeight

`double getLineHeight(TextInfo info)` <span class="joid-qualifier">abstract</span>

<a id="ITextRenderer-method-getHeight"></a>

### getHeight

`double getHeight(String text, TextInfo info)` <span class="joid-qualifier">abstract</span>

Returns the height of `text` with `info`.

<a id="ITextRenderer-method-getBaseline"></a>

### getBaseline

`double getBaseline(TextInfo info)` <span class="joid-qualifier">default</span>

Returns the distance from the top of a line to its baseline with `info`; the elements of a [`Text`](/reference/text/text/) align on it.
By default, the line height: the baseline sits at the bottom of the line.
